title: Does word salad help a RAG reader? A pre-registered paired test of the Power-of-Noise random-word claim with a local model

cost.compute_notes: NQ-open test questions with gold passages from HF florin-hf/nq_open_gold (test_dataset.json, 2,058,173 B, sha256 6393c942...). Model qwen3.5:4b (4.7B, Q4_K_M) via local Ollama 0.33.3, greedy (temperature 0, seed 0), thinking off, num_ctx 4096. 597 questions x 3 conditions = 1,791 calls, ~4-5 s per call on the local GPU, about 2 h wall-clock in background. qwen3:4b was tried first and rejected because it ignores think:false. Addendum: gemma4:latest, 200 x 3 = 600 calls, background overnight.

triggers: does random noise in the context help retrieval-augmented generation

claims.statement: Adding five length-matched word-salad documents (tokens sampled from the passage unigram distribution) before the gold passage does not change exact-answer accuracy of a 4.7B local model on NQ-open: 78.4% vs 78.6% gold-only, difference -0.2 points, 95% CI -2.7 to +2.4, discordant pairs 29/30, exact McNemar p = 1.0.
claims.scope: One model (qwen3.5:4b Q4_K_M), oracle setting (gold passage always present, placed last = nearest the question), K = 5 added documents, 597 randomly ordered NQ-open test questions, Power-of-Noise-style extraction prompt and answer-containment metric.

quantities.name: accuracy_difference_word_salad_minus_gold_only
quantities.baseline: gold only 0.7856; cuconasu2024#c4 reports +3.0 points (0.2198 -> 0.2499) with 10 random-word documents added to 8 retrieved, Llama2

quantities.name: accuracy_difference_unrelated_wikipedia_minus_gold_only
quantities.baseline: discordant 20/33, exact McNemar p = 0.098; direction opposite to cuconasu2024#c2

our_assessment.why: Analysis plan fixed before any outcome was inspected (reanalysis/ANALYSIS_PLAN.md, 15:46, after 32 questions). One deviation: the plan's stop time (17:45) passed while the session was paused, and the background job ran to 597/600 before its time limit; no outcome had been looked at and the stop did not depend on the data. By the pre-stated rule the word-salad result is INCONCLUSIVE against a +2-point effect (upper CI +2.35) but excludes the paper's own +3.0-point size in this setting. Random real passages, if anything, hurt (-2.2 points, n.s.). Narrow on purpose: one small model, oracle setting, 5 not 10 added documents, gold-only base rather than 8 retrieved. It does not refute the Power-of-Noise effect; it fails to find its strongest, mechanism-diagnostic form where it should be easiest to see. VERIFIABILITY (kb.py prereg, 2026-10-17): the original plan was written outside the repository and entered git in the SAME commit as these results (0a86509), so its precedence rests on my word and the 15:46 timestamp inside the plan, not on git.

claims.statement: Second model, pre-registered addendum (gemma4:latest, first 200 questions of the same order): word salad again does not help (65.5% vs 70.5% gold-only, -5.0 points, 95% CI -11.0 to +1.5, discordant 16/26, exact McNemar p = 0.16), and five unrelated real Wikipedia passages HURT (60.5%, -10.0 points, CI -15.5 to -4.5, discordant 8/28, p = 0.0012). The harm is mostly abstention: 'NO-RES' rises from 13.5% to 25.5% (26 questions abstain only with the extra passages, 2 the other way; exploratory).
claims.scope: gemma4:latest via local Ollama (9.6 GB file), same prompt, seeds, greedy decoding and placement (gold last) as c1; n = 200 fixed in advance (ANALYSIS_PLAN.md addendum, 20:01, before any gemma4 outcome); with n = 200 only effects of about +/-5 points are detectable. The abstention split is exploratory (not in the plan).

quantities.name: accuracy_difference_unrelated_wikipedia_minus_gold_only
quantities.baseline: exact McNemar p = 0.0012; qwen3.5:4b c1 -0.0218 (n.s.); direction opposite to cuconasu2024#c2

our_assessment.why: Pre-registered and run as planned. Across two local models the word-salad gain does not appear (point estimates -0.2 and -5.0 points; both CIs exclude the +3.0 reported by Power of Noise only for qwen). The real-passage result is the clearer one and points the OTHER way from cuconasu2024#c2: unrelated but well-formed text makes the larger model doubt itself and decline to answer, even with the gold passage sitting nearest the question. Mechanistically this is the opposite of 'noise sharpens attention': plausible text competes, word salad is ignored. Narrow: two models, oracle setting, K = 5, no retrieved distractors. VERIFIABILITY (kb.py prereg): the gemma4 addendum was committed (53ff15e, 2026-10-16 20:02) before the results first entered git (57757c6); weak form only -- git shows commit order, not generation order.

relations.why: Independent test of c4 (random-word documents help) and c2 (random documents help) in the oracle setting with a different, smaller model.
Both find the Power-of-Noise gain fragile outside its original setting.

open_questions: Same design with 10 added documents and 8 retrieved (the paper's exact Table 4 setting) -- needs a retriever over the 21M-passage corpus or the authors' retrieval files.
Position: word salad placed AFTER the gold passage (gold far from the question) -- the paper's 'Far' setting.

One more model of a different family (e.g. a Llama or Mistral) would say whether 'real passages induce abstention' is general; the gemma4 abstention split was exploratory and should be pre-registered as primary next time.
